notes:
Account: Cerulean builds an omnichannel contact center platform used by several retail brands. Large corpus: KB articles, past tickets (Zendesk), agent transcripts, product release notes. Primary ask = replace current brittle keyword search with RAG-backed agent assist that provides citation-level provenance and freshness guarantees.

Key technical requirements (from calls):
- Provide citations in responses (article id + excerpt) and confidence scores.
- Freshness: incremental indexing pipeline; publish new product KB content within 5 minutes of push.
- Multi-source retrieval: must merge results from KB, ticket history, CRM fields, and recent call transcripts; de-dup and surface best snippet.
- Reranking: hybrid signal (BM25 + embedding similarity + recency + SLA tag).
- Tool-calling: allow agent to trigger platform actions via LLM: create follow-up ticket, escalate to ops, update ticket fields (idempotent). Needs audit logs for each tool call.
- Latency targets: interactive agent assist P95 < 250ms for top-level suggestions; end-to-end including retrieval + model < 800ms for full answer.
- Throughput: baseline 150 RPS, peak bursts to 1200 RPS (marketing/product launches). Need graceful degradation and fallback to cached snippets.
- Quality monitoring: run evals against a stewarded prompt set; surface regressions to SE and SRE.
- Model preferences: open Llama-family variants for on-prem; willing to test Redwood-verified variants. Quantized 4-bit acceptable for cost.
- Data controls: strict residency for EU customers, field-level redaction, KMS integration, 1-year retention default with configurable overrides.

Customer quotes and behavior:
- "We need answers we can cite — agents want the link to the doc not just a summary." (Head of CX, 2025-03-03)
- Security and procurement teams pushing for SOC2 + ISO evidence before infra access.

POC expectations:
- 6-week POC: ingest a sliced KB + 30k tickets, demo agent sidebar with citation, tool-calling for ticket update, load test to 2x expected peak.
- Success metrics: citation precision > 85% on curated eval set, end-to-end P95 < 800ms, no data leakage in audit logs.

Notes on pricing sensitivity: Enterprise buyer but cost-aware; open to Dedicated reserved pool if it reduces per-token spend and meets SLA. Optimizer features (batching/caching) are attractive to reduce unit costs.
